items.title: iShares U.S. Consumer Discretionary (IYC) Adds Amazon and Tesla on Nov. 4
items.summary: The fund bought $244.2 million of stock, adding to 153 positions and trimming none, with $33.6 million going into Amazon.

items.title: State Street Consumer Discretionary (XLY) Adds Amazon and Tesla on Nov. 4
items.summary: The fund bought $483.1 million of stock, lifting all 47 positions and selling nothing, with $107.6 million into Amazon and $82.6 million into Tesla.

items.title: Home Depot (HD) Jumped, What Is Driving Attention Now?
